method: Read-only contract calls and static inspection of the publicly distributed Ready X extension. Extension code was not executed.

findings.meaning: Invoke request schema accepts only actions and api_version, with strict unknown-field rejection. Prepare additionally accepts simulate.
Invoke handler obtains per-token fee quotes from its paymaster service and stores them in internal transaction details; dapp action review is constructed separately.
Wallet appends the internally supplied feeAction withdrawal during action construction.
Fee UI adapter maps quote feeAction.amount into paymaster overallFee and maxFee.
Selected token quote supplies privacyFeeAmount to privacy review.

limitations: Pool values are current view results, not a reconstruction of the screenshot transaction. No transaction hash was supplied.
The downloaded extension version is not established as the exact build installed on the user device; live wallet metadata returned the string undefined.
Pool amount can be changed by its authorized configuration. Price tracking or an exact relayer pricing formula was not established.
No custom application-fee parameter exists in the inspected request handlers. This does not establish the absence of a separate private partner integration.
No transaction, signature, wallet modification, fee change, or deployment was performed.
